notes: Descriptor supplied by S78 for INTEGRATION's registry wiring; registry discoverability itself is INTEGRATION-owned. The adapter adds no behavior of its own: every action dispatches to the shipped, independently reviewed modules, and session storage kind is fixed at construction so a request cannot redirect it.

done_claim.reason: No host calls the runtime or session scripts yet (PRD-05); they are built and unit-tested but a descriptor is not a host, so they are outside the done claim until one exists. scripts/validate_selection_binding.py has a host: emit_binding_plan.emit_plan runs its validate_plan over every plan it returns, and Skill 83 checkout_instances.build calls emit_plan for every per-offer checkout set (78/tests/test_binding_plan_host.py, 83/tests/test_checkout_instances_binding_host.py). The post-selection checkout path (Skill 79 selection_flow.py and post-selection-checkout.html) is fixture-only: the wired route is per_offer_instances with selection_ref null (83-black-friday-launcher/DECISIONS-PENDING.md).

installation.note: A runtime descriptor is NOT an installation. This file advertises an entry module and action set; it proves no native page, route, or price is installed in any tenant. Installation evidence comes only from an authorized install run that emits installed_test_verified or later, never from this descriptor.

session_stores.durable: scripts/selection_session_store.py DurableSessionStore (production, tenant-scoped SQLite, chosen at Runtime construction via store={'kind': 'durable', 'base_dir': ...})
